answer: An identity earns its seat through utility bill ownership proof, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 579 aliases would need 579 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. A mirror of doubt is healthy, a raven of proof is required, and a knoll of patience is the price of a clean panel. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
